name: OpenRouteService
tagline: Open-source routing, geocoding, isochrones, and matrix APIs over OpenStreetMap
description: OpenRouteService (ORS) provides free and paid HTTP APIs for car/bike/foot routing, distance matrices, isochrones, geocoding/reverse geocoding, POI search, elevation, and optimization on OpenStreetMap data. Hosted at api.openrouteservice.org; self-hosting is also supported via open-source engines.

auth.details: API key via Authorization header (or api_key query param on some endpoints); free self-serve signup at openrouteservice.org

use_cases: get driving directions between two coordinates
compute travel-time isochrones around a point
build a distance/duration matrix for many origins and destinations
